t.zh: 一个定语从句前面有两个名词时，它修饰哪一个？从句里的动词是单数还是复数，常常给出答案。
t.en: With two nouns before a relative clause, which does it modify? Whether the clause’s verb is singular or plural often tells.

title.zh: We report the accuracy of the models that were trained on ImageNet.
title.en: We report the accuracy of the models that were trained on ImageNet.

body.zh: that were trained on ImageNet 挂在 models 上，所以它和 models 一起折进 of … 那一块。我们报告在 ImageNet 上训练的那些模型的准确率。
body.en: that were trained on ImageNet hangs on models, so it folds into the of … piece along with models. We report the accuracy of the models trained on ImageNet.

note.zh: 修饰成分跟着它修饰的词走：词折进哪一块，它也折进哪一块。
note.en: A modifier goes with its word: wherever the word is folded, so is it.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分一层层折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers layer by layer.

hint.zh: 从句里是 were：和它一致的是单数名词，还是复数名词？
hint.en: The clause has were: does it agree with a singular noun or a plural one?

tasks.sentence: We report the accuracy of the models that were trained on ImageNet.

accuracy.zh: 从句里是 were，复数；accuracy 是单数。和 were 一致的是 models：在 ImageNet 上训练的是模型。
accuracy.en: The clause has were, plural; accuracy is singular. were agrees with models: what was trained on ImageNet is the models.

folds.span: of the models that were trained on ImageNet
